note: Raise 'generation' only when a session that is already running must reload to work properly with this release (a hook added or removed, or a change an older running hook cannot live with). After any change to hooks/hooks.json or hooks/*.py, re-record hook_files_sha256 here (tests/test_pitstop.py prints the new value) and decide: same generation, or the next one. 0.1.x had no such file and counts as generation 1.
